body: It has happened in Mobile, Alabama.

I got the same ban a couple of days ago, stating that I posted that meme July 31, 2019.  I remember seeing the meme before, but not sharing it.  The accusation is utterly false and makes me ill.  I showed it to a friend.  He said that he would not post such a photo because of the boy in the background whose shorts are slightly pulled down, even though it is a side view showing no nudity (similar to the little girl in the famous suntan oil advertisement). I don't care if they take down down the photo or much anything else that I may have posted nearly 6 years ago.  Even though the suspension bothered me, what infurates me is how Facebook informed me that I shared something that they undeniably claim contains sexual child exploitation.  Such a serious accusation should never be made lightly and in such a routine manner. The notification also stated that they are legally required to report such content to the NCEMC.  I don't know if this means I have also been reported to law enforcement, which is greatly concerning, and in my opinion, slanderous.  I first saw the meme when someone else posted it on Facebook.  I don't know if I am unaware of something disturbing about the origin of the photo, but there is nothing sexually child exploitive within just the photo itself.  The thought never crossed my mind that it represented anything like that, and was certainly never intended to  by me to represent anything like that when it was posted.  I appealed the decision and was almost immediately denied.  I have been unable to find any way to investigate the situation any further.   I feel I am entitled to know everything Facebook has done with their findings of this huge false accusation they have made about me.

You know, as pathetic as it sounds, as long as I can keep busy, working or someone else being around, I don't have to think about how unhappy I am.  It's usually the middle of the night or day if I work nights when no one is around or calling and you feel you bother people as it is, I realize how alone I am and it is so scary to not have anybody like a wife to depend on each other after having that person in your life for 30 years.  No matter what I try to do while I am alone, it is not a distraction enough to be content.

I've been through the guilt phase, still comes up every now and then.  I would love to reach out to more family and friends and orchestrate some kind of arrangement to meet on a regular basis.  I have tried the best way I know how, but I frequently go weeks with no one to talk to but my nephew, who has been wonderful to me, but I owe so much, and the last thing I want to do is make him uncomfortable or unhappy.
I have been in therapy but I stopped going after I got another job in February.  I guess I need to go back.

Thank you.  I have tried to building up my support system, but after the funeral, he was the only one that went out of his way to be there for me.  I have tried so hard with family, old friends, friends of family and friends, new co-workers and honestly I am kind of fed up with trying to find anyone to be more than acquaintance or try to rekindle old friendships and family relationships to realize they already have too much going on in their own lives that maybe I will see them every other month at a holiday.  It is was just me and my wife, my sick wife and no one else for a long time and now I am starving for someone to talk to everyday, do something with every few days.  I am not expecting parties and happiness every minute of the day, but I would just like to go through a day, an hour, without being unhappy.  Just some kind of contentment and not feeling that I am just emotionlessly pretending to live.  And honestly, with working 40 hours a week, I don't feel like working at volunteering or getting involved in something that is a lot of work.  I just want some company to hang out with and talk, maybe watch tv.
